entry.description: Move the Avro RPC protocol classes (`AvroSourceProtocol`, `AvroFlumeEvent` and `Status`) from `org.apache.flume.source.avro` to `org.apache.flume.avro`, so that `AvroSource` can use the `org.apache.flume.source.avro` package. Flume 1.x clients can only connect to a Flume 2.x Avro source if they use Avro 1.11.1 or later, since Avro 1.11.0 (shipped with Flume 1.11.0) rejects the renamed `Status` enum (see https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/AVRO-3133[AVRO-3133]). Flume 2.x clients can connect to Flume 1.x Avro sources without changes.
